name: flaggems_searchsorted
description: Extracted from FlagGems searchsorted.Tensor. Finds, for each element in `values`, the insertion index into the innermost dimension of the sorted `sorted_sequence` (left/right boundary controlled by `right`/`side`), returning int32 or int64 indices. On the Ascend target the native torch.searchsorted reference has dtype and side/right semantic gaps, so the oracle runs on CPU.
